named_events.loss_description: Listed as an example catastrophe exposure in the risk section (estimated exposure table).

data.standardized_narrative: No explicit gross prior-year reserve movement figure was identified in the available pages. The technical provisions note shows gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2015 of approximately GBP 24.068m (opening reserves for 2016). The report does not present a clearly labelled gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure that could be unambiguously extracted from the scanned pages.
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction was performed from scanned page images. The gross claims outstanding (opening reserves) figure was taken from the Technical Provisions table (labelled 'Claims outstanding' - gross column) on page 26 and converted from GBP '000 to millions. I could not find an explicit gross prior-year (movement) figure or a clearly labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' in the readable scanned pages; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. The segmental (gross premium mix) tables were not reliably legible to copy exact statutory class names and amounts; gross premium total was taken from the income statement summary (87,455 GBP 000). Named-event mentions were limited; one catastrophe example table line ('Gulf of Mexico Windstorm') was legible. Because of scan quality and rotation, some numeric rows and reserve-reconciliation lines were not unambiguously readable - users should verify values against the source PDF.
